feature: Create bottom sheet (mobile presentation of CreateMenu)
detail: top-nav.tsx CreateMenu is a dropdown; ui/sheet.tsx has side=bottom but animates and draws its own X. Needs a variant with no X, no animation, a grab handle and a .32 backdrop.

feature: Create sheet option set (Start or sit / Ranking / List vs New list / League / Mock draft)
detail: Decide whether the league and mock entries stay on mobile, and whether Start or sit and Ranking show while startOrSit and weeklyRanks are off.

feature: Create → Ranking navigation
detail: Owned by the Rankings spec. Map to the weekly-ranks or new-ranking route (flag off). Don't copy the prototype's full reload to League › Match.

feature: Community header + button
detail: explore/page.tsx PageHeader has no action; Community is behind the community flag (off).

feature: My start/sit screen + header + button
detail: /app/start-or-sit pages are PlaceholderPage; there is no poll storage or API.

feature: Profile My stuff tabs + create button
detail: profile/page.tsx is 'My stats' with no My stuff tabs. The Lists tab can use existing lists data; the Start/Sit tab needs the polls backend. Which of the two list builders should mobile keep?

feature: Full-screen composer shell (header X/back, centred title, action pill, persistent scroll body)
detail: Today ListFormDialog is a centred Dialog and ListBuilder is a page. UI-only.

feature: Composer author row
detail: Use the useAuth profile username/avatar and the current week from nfl_weeks instead of the hard-coded @dalton / Week 5.

feature: Start/sit poll with 2–6 options, Start/Sit mode, pick-N, optional question title
detail: start_sit_questions stores only player_a/player_b (CHECK a≠b), votes are 'a'|'b', and no route writes it. Needs an options model, mode, pick_n, title and a POST API.

feature: Trade question poll (You give / You get, Accept/Decline)
detail: No community trade-poll table. trades/trade_votes are league trades under the leagues spec.

feature: Attach my roster + league chooser
detail: useLeagues has league name, team_count and my_team_id (no team name). Needs a post→team link and a snapshot-vs-live decision. Leagues are a flag-gated test cohort.

feature: Scoring chips on polls
detail: start_sit_questions.scoring_system_id and SCORING_PRESETS exist; saving depends on the poll API.

feature: Voting closes chips
detail: voting_closes_at and nfl_games kickoffs exist. The prototype never saves the choice. For multi-player polls, does 'At kickoff' mean the earliest kickoff?

feature: Duplicate players across poll slots
detail: The prototype allows the same player twice; the DB CHECK forbids a==b. Recommendation: prevent it in the picker.

feature: List composer step 1 (Name your list)
detail: POST /api/lists exists. The design's maxlength 40 conflicts with the API's MAX_TITLE_LEN 100.

feature: List cover colour swatches
detail: lists has no colour column, and Chris ruled on 2026-08-11 (recorded in cover-tile.tsx) that the cover background is the position group.

feature: List step 2 fields (name, description, Public switch)
detail: PATCH/POST /api/lists support these. POST still enforces FREE_PRIVATE_LIST_LIMIT (403 Upgrade to Pro) despite the Pro suspension, so a second private list fails. Needs a ruling.

feature: List videos (YouTube link add, thumbnail, remove, error)
detail: list_links via /api/lists/[id]/links (kind video, title required, max 10 links, http/https only). Require a YouTube host (the prototype regex accepts any host). Use a plain img for i.ytimg.com (no remotePatterns).

feature: List players section + empty Add players button
detail: Bulk add and per-player DELETE routes exist; ListBuilder already does create + bulk.

feature: Recommended players block
detail: Client-side filter over /api/players/builder sorted by projection. Prototype bug: a kicker first gives 0 rows under the heading.

feature: List Save flow + 'Posted to Community' toast + stay on origin
detail: Today the app toasts 'List created' and navigates to the list. The save is three non-atomic calls. Announcing a private list as 'Posted to Community' is a prototype bug.

feature: In-file ranking composer (New/Edit ranking, reorder, Publish)
detail: Unreachable in the prototype, with title 'undefined' and missing-rk crash bugs. Belongs to the Rankings spec; weekly_rankings exists, flag off.

feature: Full-screen player picker (single + multi modes)
detail: PlayerSearch, AddPlayersPopover and PlayerSidebar cover search/add. Build it as a mobile variant, not a new component.

feature: Picker search by name or exact team code
detail: The builder route supports a teams filter; name search is client-side.

feature: Picker position chips incl. K and D/ST
detail: PlayerSidebar POSITION_FILTERS has QB..K, DEF; relabel DEF as D/ST.

feature: Picker/composer player rows (headshot ring, POS·TEAM colour, Proj)
detail: PlayerRow, PositionBadge, PlayerAvatarImage and getTeamColors exist; the initials rule differs.

feature: Current-week projection in selected scoring for picker sort/display
detail: The builder route returns season projections. player_weekly_projections is scored per player only (core-stats-ops), so a bulk weekly read is needed. Also D497 says projected points are always fs-blue-deep, vs the design's grey.

feature: Picker 40-row cap
detail: The app deliberately loads the whole pool (pageAll). The cap makes players unreachable; recommend a virtualised full list.

feature: Picker empty/error state
detail: The prototype shows a blank list. Add 'No players match' and a separate error state (CLAUDE.md: 'nothing happened' must not mean 'it worked').

feature: Toast variant (bottom 100px, 1800ms, no animation)
detail: ui/toast.tsx is already an ink pill; toaster uses 4500ms with slide/fade.

feature: Mobile Switch variant (44×26, green)
detail: ui/switch.tsx is 32×19 with brand fill and a sliding knob.

feature: Chip styles (ink/b2, Start green, Sit red, circular how-many)
detail: FilterChip in ui/badge.tsx.

feature: Inter Display cv11 feature setting
detail: layout.tsx loads Inter (opsz 32); globals.css sets only tnum on .fs-num.

feature: Poll appears in Community Start-or-sit shelf
detail: use-explore-feed reads public lists only; there is no poll feed.

feature: New list first in Community 'Lists for you'
detail: The explore feed newest tab already reads recent public lists; Community flag is off.

feature: Community list cover uses YouTube thumbnail when list has videos
detail: Conflicts with the cover ruling (position-group fill + headshots).

feature: My start/sit list rows (status, votes, roster attached, crowd leans)
detail: No screen or data. Prototype bugs: 'crowd leans A. ' and the close choice is ignored.

feature: Dark mode for composer/picker/sheet
detail: CLAUDE.md says single theme, but HEAD 27d455b adds m-* light/dark tokens and theme-store citing a Chris 2026-10-15 'mobile-only dark mode' ruling. Confirm. Prototype dark bugs: white List tile and white t1-swatch cover.
